snippet.title: The Wizard of Gloss – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Wizard of Gloss is a PSX style metroidvania game with horror elements. Set in an occult water park, you will explore an interconnected, satanic labyrinth full of secrets, surprises and hidden treasures. 

The Wizard of Gloss on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533690

Find out more at Dracula's Cave:
https://draculascave.cc/
